newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian air force chief dies in plane crash.
newsitem.headline: Romanian air force chief dies in plane crash.

text.p: Romania's air force commander General Ion Stan died on Wednesday when his small plane crashed on a training flight near the western city of Timisoara, the defence ministry said.

Stan and his co-pilot were killed when the Czech-made two-seater L39 aircraft, on a meteorological reconnaissance flight, exploded on impact with the ground near the airstrip of the local army barracks, a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
A military commission is investigating the crash.
